actions.title: THE OPPORTUNITY
actions.action: Owner sets their phone down; friend notices it and glances toward the owner.

actions.title: THE PICKUP
actions.action: Friend lifts the phone into their right hand.

actions.title: CASUAL TRY
actions.action: One casual thumb touch fails; lock and a simple failure cross remain visible.

actions.title: THE EXPERT
actions.action: Friend squares shoulders, lifts chin, smirks and raises a free index finger as an overconfident solution.

actions.title: STILL NO
actions.action: The free index finger deliberately touches the same area; the lock remains and a failure cross returns.

actions.title: SHE NOTICED
actions.action: Owner turns toward the friend, raises one brow and smiles knowingly.

actions.title: GIVE IT HERE
actions.action: Owner extends an open palm; friend offers the phone, then the edit elides the transfer.

actions.title: ONE TOUCH
actions.action: Owner gives one relaxed registered-thumb touch; lock changes to a check and stays unlocked.

actions.title: CAUGHT
actions.action: Friend looks toward owner, then shoulders drop, head and eyes lower, and the smirk becomes a small frown.

actions.title: X80 HERO
actions.action: Readable upper-left main lens and two lower lenses in the X80 Cloud Window, held by owner.
